content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) for hiring project-based healthcare staff in Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Technical Assistant under advertisement number AIIMS/JDH/PED/2026/808, offering a temporary opportunity in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for Project Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Project Technical Assistant post, which will be filled on a purely temporary project basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Assistant post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹35,000/- without any additional benefits.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master's Degree in Life Sciences, Public Health, B. Pharmacy, BSc Nursing, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Assistant position is 35 years, as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026. Candidates must report between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the venue address for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to report for the walk-in interview at the Skill Lab, 1st Floor, behind College of Nursing, AIIMS, Jodhpur, along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview for the Project Technical Assistant position.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational, age, and experience documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies and recent passport-size photographs.
